title: Love this but see update
text:
Love this but see update. UPDATE: this rusts just like every other one I ever bought.

I love this little thing. You know how those cute decorative ones look nice but get so scummy and gross? It is like you got something to serve a purpose and it ends up being more work to clean the holder every day. Or you have to scrub the sink because it gets rusty or just a gross ring. This is so clean and sanitary because everything can drain out the bottom . It fits the toothpaste perfect and convenient to just throw it in the holder because if you are lazy like my teenage daughter (and me sometimes...ok I am lazy too) the toothpaste sits on the sink with globs of it all over the place instead of putting it in the cabinet.
